verdict.rationale: Keycloak's own docs say admins can manage users' sessions through the admin console and that users can manage their own sessions in the account console, so both personas have session management. The docs do not show device visibility or explicit per-session versus all-at-once revocation. Single sign-out and the token revocation endpoint are adjacent and only loosely support bulk logout. Missing for 10: documented device/session listing detail (device, browser, IP), explicit per-session and sign-out-all revocation in the admin and account consoles, admin REST session-revocation endpoints, and independent hands-on corroboration.
